# Proverbs 12 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 12:3 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Not will-be-established a-man by-wickedness, but-[the]-root-of [the]-righteous will-not be-moved. |
| LOGOS | No one is established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous will never be moved. |
| PNEUMA | Wickedness can't give you a secure foundation, but the righteous are rooted deep and immovable. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| Translator | Rendering |

| EMET | Overthrown [the]-wicked and-they-are-no-more, but-[the]-house-of [the]-righteous will-stand. |
| LOGOS | The wicked are overthrown and are no more, but the house of the righteous will stand. |
| PNEUMA | Wicked people get knocked down and disappear, but a righteous person's household endures. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| PNEUMA | People respect you for your good sense, but they despise a twisted mind. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 12:11 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | One-working his-ground will-be-satisfied [with]-bread, but-one-pursuing empty-things lacks heart. |
| LOGOS | Whoever works his land will have plenty of bread, but he who follows worthless pursuits lacks sense. |
| PNEUMA | Work the land in front of you and you'll have plenty to eat. Chase fantasies and you'll prove you have no sense. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
